messages:
Leah (AE): Quick ask from a mid-market POC: they want a compact assurance bundle — SOC 2 excerpt, ISO snapshot, short pen-test attestation (signed), a one-page map to HIPAA ePHI controls, and a sentence on Hosted vs Dedicated POC pricing/commit. Prefer a single ZIP in their dataroom. Can we turn this around tomorrow?
Omar (SE): I can grab SOC 2 excerpt and draft a 2-paragraph control summary focused on auth, encryption-in-transit+at-rest, and logging. Will include report date and auditor.
Jen (Security): Ill prepare the pen-test attestation template + an executive summary (test date, in-scope assets, top findings, remediation status). Need Legal to confirm signer. Also add a short KMS/ephemeral-creds blurb.
Aria (Legal): I can sign the attestation as Head of Legal. Please keep attestation language operationally neutral; route any redlines to Legal. Small edits I can turn around same day.
Marco (SRE): I will make a sanitized network/dataflow diagram and a hosting manifest (region, tenancy type, storage controls). No IPs/hostnames. For delivery we can either upload to dataroom or provide presigned S3 link. Example presign: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/poc-assurance.zip --expires-in 604800`
Omar (SE): Pricing note: Hosted = pay-as-you-go; Dedicated = short reservation (typical 2-week min) + onboarding. Ill include a one-row cost estimate for low/med/high usage.
Jen (Security): Staging scan policy: authenticated scans allowed in a scheduled 3-hour window with 48h notice; require contact alias. Ill add that to the README and note we don't share raw pen-test reports without NDA.
InfraBot: Ticket #POC-90055 created: "Assurance bundle for POC" assigned to Jen, Omar, Marco. Due: 2026-01-18.
Leah (AE): Action list: Jen -> attestation + exec summary + scan policy; Aria -> signer confirm; Marco -> diagram + manifest; Omar -> SOC2 excerpt + pricing note. Target ZIP upload by 16:00 PT tomorrow.
Jen (Security): Ill drop a draft attestation in the ticket by 10:00 PT tomorrow.
Marco (SRE): Diagram + manifest ETA: 11:30 PT tomorrow; will include presign fallback.
Omar (SE): SOC2 excerpt + pricing ETA: 15:00 PT tomorrow.
Aria (Legal): Pre-approving signer text now; will sign the final attestation once Jen posts it.
Leah (AE): Thanks team  Ill confirm NDA/dataroom access with the customer and update the ticket. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
